description: A simple health check script for the Notes backend that verifies the /health endpoint returns a 200 status.

methods.name: int check(url: str, attempts: int = 20, delay: float = 0.5)
methods.description: Attempts to fetch the given URL multiple times until success or attempts exhaust, returning 0 if successful and 1 otherwise.

ctags.name: check
ctags.pattern: /^def check(url: str, attempts: int = 20, delay: float = 0.5) -> int:$/
